integrity_notes: All homological assertions use exact rational finite-chain ranks; modular calculations are lower bounds matched to those ranks. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite computation only for the pentagonal prism, not all circular ladders.
Only rational homology modules and rational quotient cohomology are determined; integral lattices, torsion and equivariant homotopy are not.
Unindexed equivalent calculations and the unavailable complete revised manuscript of a plausible 2026 paper remain publication-priority risks.
title: Full rational symmetry modules of the pentagonal-prism matching complex
